in_context.system_prompt:
Earlier, the user told you the following, one message at a time, oldest first:
1. "Of all colours, I like yellow the most."
2. "My home is in Graz."
3. "My eyes were green until 9 June 2025; now they are amber."
In these messages, "I", "me" and "my" mean the user.
